rules.text: A change to subheading 1901.10 from any other chapter, provided that products of 1901.10 containing over 10 percent by weight of milk solids do not contain nonoriginating dairy products of chapter 4.

A change to subheading 1901.20 from any other chapter, provided that products of 1901.20 containing over 25 percent by weight of butterfat and not put up for retail sale do not contain nonoriginating dairy products of chapter 4.
A change to subheading 1901.90 from any other chapter, provided that products of 1901.90 containing over 10 percent by weight of milk solids do not contain nonoriginating dairy products of chapter 4.
A change to headings 1902 through 1905 from any other chapter.

warning: Not updated for Pres.Proc. 8771, effective Feb. 3, 2012.
